stations.name: CloudSignals+RiskOps™
stations.headline: See your cloud exposure. Prioritize risk. Prove compliance.
stations.summary: AI-native cloud security posture, risk operations, and continuous compliance across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. 350+ checks, a GRC-grade risk register, and evidence mapped to 20+ frameworks, delivered as SaaS, self-hosted, or air-gapped.
capabilities: Multi-cloud CSPM with real-time drift detection
Findings ranked with business-context risk scoring
Risk register, treatments, POA&Ms, and third-party risk
Continuous compliance: SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, CMMC, HIPAA
Vision AI narratives and natural-language risk chat

media.caption: Overview dashboard: posture, findings, and compliance in one view

stations.name: AI Signals™
stations.headline: Understand AI activity, performance, and governance.
stations.summary: LLM observability, evaluations, and prompt management for production AI applications. OTEL-native telemetry becomes security-native compliance signals, with MCP governance and OWASP LLM Top 10 coverage.
capabilities: OTEL-native LLM signal collection: traces, evals, prompt versions, token cost
Repeatable AI control testing and red-team evaluations
MCP trust-boundary enforcement with human approval gates
Langfuse and OpenAI-compatible endpoint integration
Governance-ready reporting for ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF

media.caption: AI provider settings: scoped model, key, and temperature per workflow

stations.name: AIRE Agentic Mesh™
stations.suite: Defense suite · Alpha · GA target Q3 2026
stations.headline: Autonomous remediation. Verified. Auditable.
stations.summary: Policy-guided remediation agents route findings to the right playbook, execute approved fixes with dry-run preview and rollback, re-scan to verify, and leave a signed evidence trail.
capabilities: Orchestration: policy-based playbook assignment and role-aware routing
Execution: cloud-native fixes on AWS, Azure, and GCP with dry-run and rollback
Verification: automated post-fix re-scan, before/after diff, signed evidence
Human approval gates via email, Slack, or Teams
Two-way Jira and ServiceNow sync

stations.name: Vision AI Optics™
stations.headline: One view of your entire risk posture.
stations.summary: Unified dashboards and AI-generated narratives for security and compliance leaders. Vision aggregates Defense and Offense signal into one data truth and explains it in plain language.
capabilities: Cross-suite posture dashboards
AI-generated risk narratives and executive summaries
Natural-language chat over findings, evidence, and compliance state
Trend analysis by control, environment, owner, or framework

media.caption: Ask about your posture in plain English

stations.name: Vision Enterprise
stations.headline: Enterprise governance at every scale.
stations.summary: Multi-tenant governance for complex, multi-region programs. Separate data, policies, and visibility by business unit, with centralized rollup, data residency controls, and board-ready reporting.
capabilities: Multi-tenant governance across business units
Custom analytics and advanced reporting
Multi-region data residency with retention, export, and purge policies
SSO, SCIM provisioning, and granular RBAC

stations.name: Fabric Intelligence Center
stations.headline: Ask. See. Act. One command interface.
stations.summary: Context-aware AI chat, contextual dashboards, and on-demand intelligence reports in one place, with agentic task execution through AIRE.
capabilities: Context-aware chat across all suites with cited sources
Role-aware answers for analysts, auditors, and executives
Launch investigations and remediation from a prompt
Custom intelligence views

stations.name: RogueAgent ASPM™
stations.suite: Offense suite · Beta · GA target Q3 2026
stations.headline: Your enterprise attack surface. Continuously mapped.
stations.summary: External asset discovery, multi-mode reconnaissance, and vulnerability signal collection across cloud, web, and infrastructure, normalized into one CVSS-scored finding schema and synced to the CloudSignals risk register.
capabilities: Subdomain, IP range, and cloud asset discovery with delta tracking
OSINT, DNS, port, and service fingerprinting pipelines
Nmap, Nuclei, Subfinder, FFUF, plus commercial scanner connectors
Scoped workspaces per client, business unit, or engagement
Audit-ready evidence export, RBAC, and SSO

stations.name: Red Teaming Scans
stations.headline: Validate defenses before the real thing.
stations.summary: Continuous adversary simulation with MITRE ATT&CK-aligned scenarios. Verify controls at scale and hand executives an attack report they can act on.
capabilities: MITRE ATT&CK scenario library
Control verification at scale
Executive-ready attack reports
Findings flow directly to AIRE for remediation

stations.name: Digital Risk Monitoring
stations.headline: See external threats before they escalate.
stations.summary: Track leaked credentials, brand exposure, dark-web mentions, and supply chain risk. Early-warning intelligence with actionable remediation paths.
capabilities: Dark web and leaked asset monitoring
Brand and domain exposure tracking
Supply chain risk signals
Early-warning alerts routed to your SIEM

rooms.name: AIRE
rooms.tagline: Coordinate approved remediation and verify changes

stations.name: Proposed work → Approval → Action → Verification
stations.headline: Every fix traceable from trigger to close.
stations.summary: The AIRE bridge is where operators watch agent playbooks move through four stages: proposed work, human approval, execution, and verification, with an immutable audit trail behind each step.
capabilities: Proposed work: finding routed to a playbook with a dry-run summary
Approval: reviewer authorizes via Teams, Slack, or email; timestamped and attributed
Action: agents execute within policy scope, rollback ready
Verification: automatic re-scan, before/after diff, signed evidence bundle

stations.name: Human in the loop
stations.headline: Findings become priorities. Priorities become decisions.
stations.summary: Every stream ends here. 3HUE advisors sit with client executives to translate Defense and Offense findings into business impact, approve remediation, and set the next 90 days.
capabilities: Business-impact framing of technical findings
Approval gates for agentic remediation, timestamped and attributed
Priority risks, progress, and decisions in one table view
Board-ready readouts

stations.name: AI Risk & Readiness Snapshot
stations.headline: 10 business days. Executive readout. A 90-day action plan.
stations.summary: Identify priority AI opportunities, uncover governance and security gaps, and establish practical next steps. Delivered by 3HUE, powered by AiVRIC.
capabilities: Discovery across cloud, AI workloads, and governance
Executive readout with prioritized risks
90-day action plan mapped to AiVRIC capabilities
Optional continuation into CloudSignals+RiskOps

rooms.name: Fabric
rooms.tagline: The shared data layer under every suite

stations.name: Six capabilities. One intelligence layer.
stations.headline: Everything your suites need, built in.
stations.summary: The Fabric is the shared foundation: unified data, AI, compute, governance, and privacy across the entire ecosystem, so every dashboard, agent, and answer draws from the same verified truth.
capabilities: GenAI Chat: cited, role-aware answers for analysts, auditors, and executives
Shared Data Layer: one schema, one index, one truth
Agentic Design: policy-gated AIRE agents with full audit trails
Efficient Compute: model routing and token optimization
Data Localization: region pinning and residency reports
AI Model Inspection: safety, bias, and hallucination monitoring
